title: tc-confetti
description: A celebration burst of confetti for a finished milestone.

fireKey.description: Change this to fire once; never fires on first render

trigger.description: "click" fires when the wrapped content is clicked

spread.description: Width of the cone the pieces leave in, in degrees

origin.description: Where a burst starts: "self" (the wrapped content; the viewport's top when bare), "viewport-top", or "x,y" in viewport pixels

colors.description: CSS colours for the pieces; by default the chart tokens and the success colour

seed.description: Seed for the pattern; each burst uses the next one

announce.description: Said politely once per burst, e.g. "Review closed"
